questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

As increasing dependence on information systems develop (1)/ the need for such systems (2)/ to be reliable and secure also becomes more essential. (3)/ No error (4).
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Here, concept of subject - verb agreement is brought under consideration. Since, subject **increasing dependence **is a 3rd person singular noun. Hence, the verb used should also be singular. Hence, replace **develop **with **develops. **So, option 1 is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **As increasing dependence on information systems develops the need for such systems to be reliable and secure also becomes more essential.

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

Like most combat ofﬁcers who had seen their men die (1)/ and occasionally buried the hideously (2)/ mutilated bodies of those unlucky enough to taken alive. (3)/ No error (4).
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Here, concept of to + infinitive is brought under consideration. The to-infinitive i.e. to + V1 is used in many sentence constructions, often expressing the purpose of something or someone's opinion about something. So, replace **taken **with **take. **Thus, option 3 is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **Like most combat ofﬁcers who had seen their men die and occasionally buried the hideously mutilated bodies of those unlucky enough to take alive.

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be ﬁlled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

Four braces of partridges ______ been bought.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Here, concept of passive voice is brought under consideration. Sometimes, subject is not mentioned in the passive voice, thus use of **by **is also omitted. Since, blank is followed by **been **which is used with forms of 'have'. That is, 

Object + has/have + been + Verb's 3rd form.

So, options 3 & 4 are eliminated. Since, object is **four braces **which is a plural noun. Hence, plural verb to be used. So, option 2 is eliminated. Thus, option 1 i.e. **have **is the correct answer. 

**Correct sentence - **Four braces of partridges have been bought.

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be ﬁlled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

She ______ of going to Paris.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Here, concept of simple present tense is brought under consideration. Thus, option 4 is eliminated. When, 'he, she, it or 3rd personal singular is used as a subject. So, s/es is used with the main verb. Thus, option 1 is eliminated. Now, with reference to the context, she wants to go to Paris. And, the most appropriate word that fits the blank is **dreams. **Hence, option 3 is omitted. Thus, option 2 i.e. **dreams **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **She dreams of going to Paris.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.**

NOVEL
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of given word 'novel' :- Something of new kind; different from anything seen or known before; unique.

Whereas, words like 'common, usual & overused' means something which is general or widespread. Hence, word **unique **best expresses the meaning of the given word 'novel'. So, option 1 i.e. **unique **is the correct answer.

questions.question:

questions.solution:

Whereas, words 'ample, plenty & abundant' describe in large amount that is more than sufficient.

Hence, option 1 i.e. **limited **is the correct answer.

Now, find the meaning of options :-

Artful - Full of art and creativity.

Ingenuous - Free from reserve, restraint; candid; artless; innocent; naive.

Thus, the word **artful **best describes the meaning of given word 'wily'. Hence, option 2 i.e. **artful **is the correct answer.

questions.question:

Whereas, 'serious' means not happy; sad; having deep thoughts. Thus, it is opposite in meaning to 'jolly'. So, option 1 i.e. **serious **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

Delinquency is a

P: the course of normal social life

Q: kind of normality when

R: an individual deviates from
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Since, the starter of the passage ends with an article **a**, thus it cannot be followed by an article **the **again. Hence, options 1 & 3 are eliminated. Now, the sentence cannot end with a preposition **from. **Hence, option 4 is eliminated. Thus, option 2 i.e. **QRP **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **Delinquency is a kind of normality when an individual deviates from the course of normal social life.

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

Child malnutrition is the

Q: is facing today even when

R: biggest challenge that our country
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Clearly, the starter of the passage ends with an article **the, **hence, it will not be followed by itself. So, option 1 is eliminated. Also, starter has verb** is, **thus it cannot be followed by verb directly. So, options 1 & 4 are eliminated. Thus, option 1 i.e. **RQP **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **Child malnutrition is the biggest challenge that our country is facing today even when the economy is said to be surging ahead.

questions.question: Rishabh is 15th from left end and 23rd from right end in a row of students. How many students are there in the row?

questions.question: What is the value of (0.5)² + (0.05)² + (0.005)²?

∴ LCM of (7/5) and (9/25) = 63/5

P can do a piece of work in 20 days and Q can do the same piece of work in 60 days. They start working together and work for 5 days and then both leave the work. R alone ﬁnishes the remaining work in 10 days. In how many days will R alone ﬁnish the whole work?
questions.solution:
Work done by P in 1 day = 1/20

Work done by Q in 1 day = 1/60

Work done P and Q in 1 day = 1/20 + 1/60 = 1/15

Work done by P and Q in 5 days = 5 ⨯ 1/15 = 1/3

∴ P and Q finished 1/3rd of the work in 5 days.

R finished 2/3rd of the work in 10 days

2/3 work = 10 days

1 work = 10 × (3/2) = 15 days

questions.question: The ratio of the length and breadth of a rectangle is 7 : 4. If the perimeter of the rectangle is 220 cm, then what is the breadth (in cm) of the rectangle?

⇒ 11x = 110

⇒ x = 10 cm

∴ Breadth of rectangle = 4 × 10 = 40 cm

questions.question: A shopkeeper allows two successive discounts of 20% and 10% on selling an article. If he gets Rs. 432 for the article, then what is the marked price (in Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Short Trick:**

Marked price of the article = 432 ×(100/80) × (100/90)

= Rs. 600

**Detailed Solution:**

Let the marked price be x

Discount = 20% of x = 0.2x

SP after initial discount = x - 0.2x = 0.8x

2ⁿd Discount = 10% of 0.8x = 0.1 × 0.8x

Final SP = 0.8x - 0.1 × 0.8x = 0.72x

⇒ 0.72x = 432

∴ x = 432/0.72 = Rs. 600

questions.question: A trader gives a discount of 30% on the marked price. To earn proﬁt of 5%, by how much percent should he mark the price of his goods higher than its cost price?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price be x

Gain = 5% of x = 0.05x

Required SP = x + 0.05x = 1.05x ----(1)

Now SP is also obtained after giving a discount of 30% on MP

Let the MP be y

Discount = 30% of y = 0.3y

SP = y - 0.3y = 0.7y ----(2)

From (1) and (2):

1.05x = 0.7y

⇒ y = 1.5x ----(3)

% difference between CP and MP = (y - x) ⨯ 100/x

(1.5x - x) ⨯ 100/x = 0.5 ⨯ 100 = 50%

∴ MP should be 50% higher than the CP.

questions.question: The average of N numbers is 15. If a number 3 is removed, then average becomes 18. What is the value of N?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Average of N numbers = 15

New average after removing '3' = 18

**CALCULATION:**

Average of N numbers = 15

Sum of N numbers = 15 ⨯ N = 15N

Now 3 is removed = Average of (N - 1) numbers = 18

Sum of (N - 1) numbers = 18 ⨯ (N - 1) = 18N - 18

Sum of N numbers - 3 = Sum of (N - 1) numbers

⇒ 15N - 3 = 18N - 18

⇒ 3N = 15

∴ N = 15/3 = 5

questions.question: The speed of a stream is 1 km/hr. A boat goes 36 km and comes back to the starting point in 15 hours. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the boat in still water?
questions.solution:
Let the speed of boat in still water be ‘u’

⇒ Speed upstream = u - 1

⇒ Speed downstream = u + 1

Distance travelled = 36 km

⇒ Time to travel upstream = t1 = 36/(u - 1)

⇒ Time to travel downstream = t2 = 36/(u + 1)

Now, t1 + t2 = 15 hours

36/(u - 1) + 36/(u + 1) = 15

[1/(u - 1) + 1/(u + 1) = 15/36

2u/(u² - 1) = 5/12

5u² - 24u - 5 = 0

u = - 1/5 km/hr or 5 km/hr

∴ speed of boat in still water = u = 5 km/hr (∵ Speed cannot be negative)

questions.question: The downstream speed of a boat is 20 km/hr and the speed of current is 5 km/hr. What is the total time (in hours) taken by the boat to cover 80 km upstream and 100 km downstream?
questions.solution:
Downstream speed = 20 km/hr

Speed of current = 5 km/hr

Speed of boat in still water = 20 - 5 = 15 km/hr

Speed upstream = speed of boat in still water - speed of current = 15 - 5 = 10 km/hr

Time taken to go 80 km upstream = 80/10 = 8 hours

Time taken to go 100 km downstream = 100/20 = 5 hours

∴ Total time = 8 + 5 = 13 hours

⇒ 1.3456x = 403680

⇒ x = 403680/1.3456 = 300000

∴ Population 2 years ago = 3,00,000

questions.question: India is a Union of States. Executive power of the Union is vested in the ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**President.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The executive power of the Union is vested in the President, and according to the Constitution is exercised by him either directly or through officers subordinate to him**__. The supreme command of the Defense Forces of the Union also vests in him.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The President summons, prorogues, addresses, sends messages to the Parliament and dissolves the Lok Sabha, issues ordinances at any time except when both the Houses of Parliament are in session, makes recommendations for the introduction of Financial and Money Bills, and grants, grants clemency, in certain cases remits, relieves or suspends or suspends punishment, and commutes or commutes punishment.
 
• When there is a failure of the constitutional machinery in a state, he can take over all or any of the functions of the government of that state.
 
• The President can declare an emergency in the country if he is satisfied that a serious emergency exists, which threatens the security of India or any part of its territory, whether by war or external aggression or armed rebellion.

questions.question: Why does the oil move up in the lamp?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Capillary action**__.

__CONCEPT__:

 
• Capillarity: If a tube of the very narrow bore (called capillary) is dipped in a liquid, it is found that the liquid in the capillary either ascends or descends relative to the surrounding liquid. This phenomenon is called capillarity.
 
• The root cause of capillarity is the difference in pressures on two sides of the (concave and convex) curved surface of the liquid.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe6d8e50e4593a64912878e3c15916d9d2f96f114503286f78875e506d63d603.png] 

 
• Capillary action draws the ink to the tips of fountain pen nibs from a reservoir or cartridge within the pen.
 
• This thread used in lanterns is also known as the wick and because of the capillary action of liquid kerosene keeps rising in a wick and helps it burn.
